title: MusicCandidate
description: Music generation results — array of candidate tracks. User selects one; the choice is recorded at top level. Pure domain data; frontend auto-renders a candidate grid with audio players.

selected_candidate_index.description: Index into `candidates` of the chosen track; null until the user picks one.

selected_audio_url.description: Canonical downstream `music_url`, copied from `candidates[selected_candidate_index].audio_url`. null until selection is final.

audio_url.description: Vendor-hosted or GCS-mirrored audio. `.mp3` / `.wav` triggers the auto audio player.

cover_url.description: Optional cover art. `.jpg` / `.png` etc. triggers the auto cover image.

description.description: Optional short note (vendor name, evaluation summary, etc.). Keep brief.
